visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A man with a dark goatee and a grey baseball cap, dressed in a brown technician-style jumpsuit, sits on a tan leather couch in a modern, brightly lit living room. He looks directly at the camera and speaks with active facial expressions. Behind him, minimalist white walls and a large window providing soft daylight are visible. (2) The scene transitions to a medium shot of a row of passengers on a public transit train, mostly men in casual attire, all focused on their handheld smartphones. One woman in the group wears large white and red headphones. (3) Returning to the man on the couch, he gestures expansively and pulls a small red square device from his chest pocket to present it to the lens. (4) A top-down close-up shows the red device's digital screen as a finger taps through menu options like Angle and Level, highlighting the red and black interface. (5) The man holds the red device alongside a blue digital level and a green laser distance meter, comparing their physical forms. (6) A yellow metal tape measure is shown in a tight close-up being pulled across a doorway to measure the frame, representing traditional methods. (7) Back in the living room, the man points toward the ceiling where a small red laser dot is clearly visible, demonstrating the device's distance-measuring function. (8) Side-by-side close-ups compare the digital readings of the professional green Makita meter and the red QUBE device, both displaying identical numerical values. (9) The man places the red device atop a long blue industrial level; the device's screen reacts with a digital crosshair, showing its sensitivity as he gently tilts the assembly. (10) A small circular inset appears in the corner featuring a young woman with long dark hair, identified as Gloria, as the man discusses technical details. (11) A montage shows the red device being placed against tiled bathroom walls and on the floor of a kitchen, showing its practical application in interior design. (12) A high-speed industrial shot shows a CNC machine cutting metal with coolant spraying, providing context for precision engineering requirements. (13) The man holds the red device close to the camera, tapping its plastic outer shell to demonstrate its construction and texture. (14) The video concludes with the red device sitting on a wooden table while a large white 85 appears as a final score, followed by a red screen with promotional text and a discount code.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video serves as a comprehensive tech review and promotion for the QUBE 3-in-1 measurement device. It uses comparative testing against professional-grade tools to validate the product's accuracy and utility for home renovation and interior design enthusiasts. The narrative aims to demystify crowdfunding gadgets by providing factual evidence of performance, ultimately encouraging viewers to purchase using a provided discount code.
